column6: Speak to my lord: this is what @wPN{@wDN{Sîn}-illat} the general, your servant, says:
When I moved opposite @wSN{Kakkulātum}, the @wEN{Martu} rose up from their ambush with their weapons. When I ……, I captured 70 …… and brought them into @wSN{Kakkulātum}.

If my lord arranges for the troops to encamp, let him have them take their tied-up leather sacks. If my lord arranges for the troops not to encamp, @varh[t3201.v1]{then let them stay put } @vart[t3201.v2,t3201.v1]{@varn{2 mss. have instead:} then let them go }. @varh[t3201.v3]{May my lord know } @vart[t3201.v4,t3201.v3]{@varn{1 ms. has instead:} This is urgent }!
